svg.title: Uniform and parabolic velocity profiles in a tube
svg.desc: Two vertical tube cross sections show upward flow. An ideal inviscid uniform-flow model has equal velocity arrows. Fully developed laminar flow of a Newtonian fluid in a circular tube has a parabolic profile with zero speed at both walls, maximum speed at the center, and mean speed equal to half the maximum. Both panels have the same mean speed. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Tracer rows reveal the velocity profile
